shader: Tile along the stands. Pick the set from the crowd level (calm 0-3, into_it 4-7, wild 8-11) and swap A/B on the beat. Bounce: slot = floor(uv.x * size.x / slot_px); phase = hash(slot + section_id); offset_y = amplitude(crowd level) * max(0, sin(beat_phase * 2pi + phase * 2pi)). Phone lights and waves can be layered in the same shader.
